title: Marigold Corporation, semiweekly depositor with Schedule B

status.note: Composed and schema-valid offline (AtsScenarioComposeTest). Send after ATS reopens on 2026-10-13, and only if Pyramos will file Schedule B returns in production (Pub 5078 section 2.5.1).

summary: A Q1 2026 Form 941 for a semiweekly schedule depositor, so it carries a Schedule B with daily tax liabilities. It has 10 employees and $33,594 in wages. Deposits exceed the tax, and the employer asks for the overpayment as a refund.
tests: Line 16 semiweekly depositor checkbox, which requires a Schedule B attachment
Schedule B daily liabilities across all three months (days 11 and 20, 1 and 18, 10 and 19)
Schedule B monthly and quarterly totals reconcile to 941 line 12 (8,715.89)
Social security (12.4%) and Medicare (2.9%) flowing into lines 5e, 6, 10 and 12
Overpayment of $284.11 on line 15a with 'Send a refund' checked on line 15b
Two-document ReturnData (IRS941 + IRS941ScheduleB) linked by documentId

keyFigures.label: Total social security and Medicare taxes

notes: The city is spelled 'Philadelephia' on page 1 of the Form 941. The client body keeps the typo on purpose, because it is IRS test data.
Lines 5b, 5d, 7-9 and 11 are blank on the form and absent from the XML.
The Schedule B quarter checkbox (Quarter 1) matches the 941 quarter.
